glyph_reference.palette: Reference deliberately uses JVM fixture theme colours: light stroke23/muted245, dark stroke250/muted38. It isolates geometry, not a website palette pixel snapshot. Actual catalog/website palette is separately measured.

title.font_analysis_limitation: Hint table differences and nonmatching decomposed command structures are diagnostic; no full outline-equality or single-cause raster attribution is claimed.

browser.crop_policy: Floor top/left, ceil width/height; copy original pixels without fractional source-rectangle interpolation.

scope: Catalog current vector and reproducible recipe only; no public component API/dependency/font resource change. Whole component and site audit remain open.
warnings: Existing AGP experiment flags, Gradle deprecation and webpack warnings; historical Text.kt invisible-reference warning remains outside this change.
